topic: T6_star - Host star parameters and activity
summary: All star values printed in U/proposed_revision/manuscript.tex are reproduced from raw inputs. Two MINOR wording fixes: 'no infrared excess' should rest on the WISE W1-W4 colours, not on ARIADNE (fit only to W2); RUWE 1.21 is at the 60th-64th percentile of all comparable stars but the 74th among apparently single stars and the 86th-90th among RUWE<1.4, so 'typical' should become 'below the usual 1.4 threshold'. ARIADNE: both .dat files are reproduced exactly from BMA.pkl, and their error bars are artefacts. The 'weighted average' is a sum of independent draws (about 2x too narrow), and the HDR routine uses a 300-point KDE against a 499-bin CDF (about 1.7x too wide). The correct mixture gives Teff 4017 +58/-64 K, R 0.620 +0.020/-0.018 Rsun and L 0.0901 +- 0.002 Lsun, so 4020 +- 60 K and 0.62 +- 0.02 Rsun are right; the composite 4030 +- 90 K input agrees. Distance 35.577 +- 0.022 pc (zero point -0.033245 mas); 28.075 mas is the raw parallax used in U 08_fpp TRICERATOPS (negligible effect). Gaia RV is not variable under the official DR3 rule (gof 3.0 < 4). Activity: no rotation period is measured; the ~8 d catalogue signals come from a single TESS sector; Halpha and Ca IRT are in absorption and there are no flares. Under Wright+2011 the marginal eRASS1 level points to P ~ 13-50 d. [Fe/H], age and rotation stay unknown; none blocks the Note.
